summary: Performance Shipping Inc., a Greek-flag foreign private issuer (US-equivalent Form 8-K current report via Form 6-K), announced separately negotiated agreements with certain warrant holders to repurchase and cancel warrants: Class A for up to 190,000 shares at $0.20 per underlying share, plus July 19, 2022 warrants (859,999 shares), August 16, 2022 warrants (1,699,306 shares) and Series B warrants (3,313,250 shares) at $0.60 per underlying share. Maxim Group LLC is financial advisor. Stated compliance with bank loan, sale-and-leaseback and 9.875% 2029 bond covenants. Remaining overhang includes Class A at $15.75 and July/August 2022 warrants at $1.65. Watch for dilution reduction versus cash outflow.
